title: Gujarat Launches India's 1st State-Level 'Viksit Gujarat Data Centre Policy 2026-29'
summary: Targets ₹6 lakh crore investment and 7.5 GW data centre capacity in Gandhinagar.

blocks.title: 📰 4. 🌐 NATIONAL, STATE & INTERNATIONAL NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Gujarat Launches India's 1st State-Level 'Viksit Gujarat Data Centre Policy 2026-29'. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Targets ₹6 lakh crore investment and 7.5 GW data centre capacity in Gandhinagar.
Policy Targets: Aims to attract ₹6 lakh crore investment and develop 7.5 GW (up to 8 GW) data centre capacity.
Fiscal Incentives: Capital/interest subsidies, power tariff support, SGST reimbursement, and 20-year tax holiday alignment.
Data Infrastructure Gap: India generates ~20% of global data but holds only ~3% of global data centre capacity (US & China hold 70%).
India global data generation share (~20%) vs global data centre capacity share (~3%).
